title: U.S. Bancorp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: U.S. Bancorp filed an 8-K current report disclosing the voting results from its 2026 annual shareholder meeting held on April 21, 2026. Shareholders elected all twelve director nominees, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified Ernst & Young LLP as the independent auditor. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: U.S. Bancorp held its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders on April 21, 2026.

All twelve director nominees were elected, including Warner L. Baxter, Dorothy Bridges, Elizabeth L. Buse, Alan B. Colberg, Kimberly N. Ellison-Taylor, Aleem Gillani, Roland A. Hernandez, Gunjan Kedia, Richard P. McKenney, Yusuf I. Mehdi, Loretta E. Reynolds, and John P. Wiehoff.
Shareholders approved executive compensation on an advisory basis with 1,138,199,345 votes for, 79,171,164 against, and 5,971,212 abstentions.
Shareholder proposal 3 regarding auditor ratification (Ernst & Young LLP) was voted on but the full results were truncated in the filing.
The filing was submitted under Item 5.07 (Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders).
